description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressively applying work in batches, especially for UI updates that can be deferred to avoid blocking. It manages batching, progress reporting, and cancellation, designed to be used in React components with optional fallback to setTimeout if requestIdleCallback is unavailable.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object that manages batch processing with progress reporting and cancellation, utilizing requestIdleCallback or setTimeout for scheduling.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: A React hook that wraps the or createProgressiveExpandController to provide UI state management for batch processing, including starting, progress, and canceling.
